_comment: Where each bundled artifact came from, so `gameversion.status()` can say
whether it still matches the installed game. Regenerate an entry's
`gameBuild` whenever you re-run its script against a new install.
A null `gameBuild` means the origin build is genuinely unknown, not that it
is current. `gameversion` reports that as 'unknown' rather than assuming a
match, because a wrong-but-plausible map is worse than an honest banner.

gamedata.json.gz.note: Extracted from a third-party data dump rather than from the game pak, so it has no build id. Item, Pal, skill and technology tables change only when the game adds content; the archive is versioned by its own release, not by a Steam build.

effigies.json.gz.note: 396 positions and instance GUIDs, read from the always-loaded relic cell. Positions are static per build; a content update can move or add relics.

pal_breeding.json.gz.source: tylercamp/palcalc precomputed table, layered with refs/PalWorldSaveTools-main.zip
pal_breeding.json.gz.note: 44,850 precomputed pairs plus the game's own combi/unique tables. Neither source is a pak, so there is no build id. Breeding results change only when Pals are added or the combi table is edited.

pal_db.json.gz.note: Per-Pal breeding attributes (rank, gender ratio) backing the planner. Same sources as pal_breeding.json.gz and regenerated by the same script.

worldobjects.json.gz.note: 35,687 ore nodes, chests, fishing spots and oil fields across 3,471 cells. The most update-sensitive artifact here: terrain edits move these.
